name: Wisconsin Policy Forum 2026 Property Values and Taxes DataTool
what: September 2026 interactive tool comparing equalized property values, levies and tax rates for every Wisconsin municipality.
pitch: Statewide levies posted their biggest jump in nearly two decades; this puts Wausau, Weston, Rothschild and Marathon towns on the same axis as peers, with per-municipality history.
access: Release · Wisconsin Policy Forum · free (Tableau tool plus media release PDF)

name: DWD August 2026 Local Employment and Unemployment Data
what: Monthly BLS estimates of unemployment and employment for all 72 Wisconsin counties, 13 metros, largest cities.
pitch: Released Sept 23; rates rose year-over-year in 64 of 72 counties. Marathon County and the Wausau MSA are in every monthly file — a ready recurring tracker WPR lacks.
access: Release · Wisconsin DWD (BLS LAUS) · free (next: Sept data Oct 21)

name: DNR EM PFAS — Municipal System PFAS Sampling
what: Point layer of PFAS sampling results at Wisconsin municipal drinking water systems, refreshed September 26, 2026.
pitch: Direct feed for the existing PFAS and drinking water tracker: new sampling rounds at Wausau, Rothschild, Mosinee and Kronenwetter systems, with detections and compound-level results.
access: Update · WI DNR Open Data · free (GeoJSON/CSV/API download)

name: WisDOT STIP Projects (4 Year) and Construction Projects (2 Year)
what: Line layers of programmed state transportation projects for the next four and two years, updated September 26.
pitch: Gives Marathon County a forward calendar of highway work — the planning counterpart to WPR's 511WI road conditions tracker — with cost, program and improvement type per project.

name: DPI 2025-26 School and District Report Cards
what: Annual accountability ratings for every Wisconsin school and district, with a downloadable statewide data file.
pitch: Secure preliminary release hits districts October 1 and the inquiry window closes October 12; public release with the annual download lands in November — time to build the Marathon County comparison now.
access: Coming next month · Wisconsin DPI · free (public file November, secure release Oct 1)

name: DNR EM PFAS — Surface Water and Fish Tissue Sampling
what: Point layer of PFAS results in Wisconsin surface waters and fish tissue, refreshed September 26, 2026.
pitch: Extends the PFAS tracker beyond tap water to the Wisconsin River, Lake Wausau and Big Eau Pleine — the waters people actually fish, tied to DNR consumption advisories.
access: Update · WI DNR Open Data · free (GeoJSON/CSV/API)

name: DNR Remediation and Redevelopment — Sediment Impacts Boundary
what: Polygon boundaries of Wisconsin sediment study and cleanup project areas, refreshed September 26, 2026.
pitch: Adds an areal dimension to the BRRTS contamination tracker, which is point-based: sediment study areas show how far river-bottom contamination extends near Wausau's riverfront redevelopment.
access: Update · WI DNR Open Data · free (GeoJSON/shapefile download)

name: DNR Solid Waste – Landfills and Historic Waste Site Extents
what: Statewide points and polygons for active, inactive and historic landfill and waste disposal sites.
pitch: Historic dumps are the contamination story BRRTS alone misses: closed sites next to homes, schools and new subdivisions. Statewide, parcel-scale, and it refreshed October 8.
access: Update · WI DNR · free, open download (GeoJSON/CSV/shapefile + ArcGIS REST API)

name: DNR Remediation and Redevelopment – Wisconsin Assessment Monies (WAM) Award Location Points
what: Point locations of DNR brownfield assessment grants awarded to address closed or closing industrial sites.
pitch: Puts public dollars on the map at the exact brownfields WPR already tracks in BRRTS, and at the parcels cities later wrap in TIF districts. Refreshed October 8.
access: Update · WI DNR · free, open download (GeoJSON/CSV/shapefile + ArcGIS REST API)

name: WisDOT Airport FAR Part 77 Surfaces
what: New statewide polygons of federal imaginary airspace surfaces around every Wisconsin airport runway.
pitch: First public statewide version, issued October 1. Central Wisconsin Airport in Mosinee and Wausau Downtown Airport both throw height-restricted surfaces across land that developers keep proposing to build on.
access: New dataset · WisDOT · free, open download (GeoJSON/shapefile + ArcGIS REST API)

name: DNR Remediation and Redevelopment – Sediment Impacts Points
what: Point features for activities with current or past sediment contamination in Wisconsin waterways.
pitch: The point companion to the sediment boundary layer, and easier to geocode and list. Wisconsin River impoundments through Marathon County carry legacy sediment contamination that pairs with PFAS fish-tissue work.
access: Update · WI DNR · free, open download (GeoJSON/CSV/shapefile + ArcGIS REST API)

name: CDC Epidemic Trends and Rt: COVID-19, Influenza, and RSV
what: Archived time-varying reproductive number estimates and epidemic trend categories at national, state and local levels.
pitch: Issued October 2 and updating on a schedule, with Wisconsin values and history back through prior seasons. Exactly the recurring backbone WPR's scoped communicable-disease tracker lacks.
access: New dataset · CDC · free, open data (Socrata API, CSV/JSON)

name: WisDOT WEVI EV Charging Stations
what: Sites awarded fast-charging funding under Wisconsin's Electric Vehicle Infrastructure program, with location attributes.
pitch: A public-money siting dataset refreshed September 8, covering the I-39/51 and Highway 29 corridors through Marathon County. Awards are tied to named host businesses and host municipalities.
access: Update · WisDOT · free, open download (GeoJSON/CSV/shapefile + ArcGIS REST API)

name: Wisconsin Policy Forum: Condo Production Continues to Lag in Wisconsin (Focus #12)
what: September 2026 statewide brief on condominium construction trends and the housing-supply gap.
pitch: Condo and owner-occupied multifamily supply is the missing piece in Wausau's downtown housing debate, and the Forum's housing briefs typically carry underlying permit counts WPR can localize.
access: Release · Wisconsin Policy Forum · free PDF

name: Wisconsin Policy Forum: Chronic Absenteeism briefing (Forum Friday, Oct. 30)
what: Scheduled Forum release and briefing on Wisconsin's persistently high chronic absenteeism rates.
pitch: Dated and plannable. Forum education releases usually come with district-level tables, which would drop straight into WPR's DPI education tracker alongside ACT scores and dropout rates.
access: Coming next month · Wisconsin Policy Forum · free (public briefing and report)
